title.narrative: Water Institute of Southern Africa –Young water professionals ZA-DK exchange program

description.narrative: -Facilitate a knowledge and skills exchange between YWPs from the all over the world on key issues relating to respective national challenges - Integrate unique individual and country expertise to come up with viable solutions to address skills shortage, high youth unemployment rates, lack of inclusivity in the water sector, inequalities in access to water and sanitation, etc - Identify, network/engage key stakeholders during both conferences and on-board them as key partners to be involved during implementation of the outcomes of the workshop - Develop an action plan and prepare a position paper to be submitted to relevant Parliamentary Portfolio Committees - Use the workshop findings to inform the YWP chapter activities including the biennial conferences - Publish articles detailing the much needed critical skills of the future that can transform the water sector and make the youth employable - Gathering information that will inform the development of short courses/training modules to upskill YWPs through IWA, WISA, EWSeta, Imvelisi and/or universities

The YWP ZA aims to facilitate the -exchange program during the IWA and WISA conferences to foster knowledge exchange, enable capacity building, aid professional development, support youth empowerment, encourage water innovation for social good and strengthen existing relationships between the two chapters, and between the YWP-ZA and the Royal Danish Embassy in South Africa. The exchange will aid and complement the planned activities by the collaboration between both governments and facilitate the development of a list of critical skills of the future needed to transform the water sector and to achieve SDG 5, 6, 10, 11 (particularly 8). The successful attainment of this grant opportunity will allow for critical solutions to be formulated to fill the skills gaps, address youth unemployment and various challenges in the water sector in both countries. This will be achieved through the facilitation of an exchange by vast individuals from different country perspectives. YWP-ZA is eager and equipped to manage this exchange to unlock more opportunities for empowering YWPs, solve the skills shortage barrier to adoption of innovations, promote inclusivity and socioeconomic development and future proof the sector.
